incident-bot: PAGER -> tenant=aurelia (prod-vpc-us-west-2) KV/prefix cache hit-rate sudden drop 94% -> 2% within 9m; request error spike and tail latency >4s. Auto-page to oncall. Incident ID: INC-1992001234.
Lina SRE: ack, paging in. Alex, you're oncall now. Sam, can you confirm customer symptoms?
Alex Oncall: Im online. Sam?
Sam (CS - AureliaHealth): Aurelia reports widespread timeouts on their batch scoring endpoints since ~09:12 PDT. They see 502/504 and slow responses on large batches. Impacting paying customers on dedicated VPC. They've started rolling back heavy batch jobs.
Priya (eng-runtime): quickly attaching metrics:
```
[2026-04-02T09:12:08Z] cache_stats: tenant=aurelia hit_rate=1.9% keys=8.2M evictions=95k/s
[2026-04-02T09:13:01Z] prefetch: concurrency=600 tenant=aurelia queue=1200
[2026-04-02T09:13:37Z] mem_pressure: cache_shard=3 usage=92% warnings
```
Initial theory: client is producing high-cardinality prefixes (session-specific prefixes) causing prefetch storm and eviction thrash; some cache partitions hitting OOM pressure and falling back to KV disabled path.
Lina SRE: severity P1 - customer visible. Immediate mitigation options: A) disable prefetch for tenant B) throttle prefetch worker for tenant C) evict noisy prefix ranges D) route to smaller model to reduce memory usage. Which first?
Alex Oncall: do A + C now. Priya, can you toggle prefetch? Nico, prep routing fallback.
Priya (eng-runtime): running: `redwoodctl config set prefetch.enabled=false --tenant aurelia --env prod-vpc-us-west-2`
ops-bot: config updated by Priya at 2026-04-02T09:15:12Z.
Priya (eng-runtime): starting targeted eviction for prefix pfx:/aurelia/session/
`redwoodctl cache evict --tenant aurelia --prefix "pfx:/aurelia/session/" --batch 50000 --confirm`
ops-bot: eviction job queued, progressing.
Nico (eng-platform): routing change queued: `redwoodctl route update --tenant aurelia --policy spill-to-dedicated-lowmem --model rwd-small-1` will take ~45s.
Sam (CS - AureliaHealth): Aurelia confirms initial improvement for interactive users, but batch pipelines still show some failures. They ask for ETA for full restoration.
Priya (eng-runtime): monitoring: hit-rate climbing 1.9% -> 27% after first eviction wave. Eviction rate stabilizing, mem pressure easing to 70%. Latency p95 down from 4.2s -> 1.8s.
Lina SRE: good. Keep prefetch disabled until root cause identified. Alex continue incident lead for comms. Priya to take runtime owner on RC.
Priya (eng-runtime): traced requests: many keys look like `pfx:/aurelia/session/<uuid>-attempt-<timestamp>`. SDK v2.5 seems to include ephemeral suffixes per invocation. Raising bug with SDK team. Sample trace: https://redwood.prod/traces/xyz789
Alex Oncall: ask CS to tell customer we've mitigated and are investigating root cause and SDK fix ETA. Sam, pass a temporary recommended workaround to customer: pin SDK to v2.4 or disable client-side per-request session suffix.
Sam (CS - AureliaHealth): sending message now. Customer will test pin to v2.4 and report back. They requested that we run a safety cap to prevent recurrence.
Nico (eng-platform): logging suggestion: add per-tenant metric unique_prefix_rate and an auto-guard to disable prefetch when unique_prefixs/min > 5k. I can spin up a short-term config flag in platform.
Priya (eng-runtime): creating a quick patch to throttle prefetch worker concurrency for tenant aurelia and to add de-dupe for prefix keys on our side. Draft PR: github.com/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/7421 (WIP).
Lina SRE: handoff: we'll monitor for 1h post-mitigation. Success criteria: hit-rate >60% and p95 <800ms. If either fails, escalate to oncall backfill and possible muted rollback of prefetch.
Alex Oncall: documenting timeline and comms. I'll open the postmortem and tag owners: runtime (Priya), platform (Nico), SDK (client team), CS (Sam), SRE (Lina).
ops-bot: Incident update -> status=mitigating impacted=[aurelia] started=1992001234 updated=1992001505
Priya (eng-runtime): snapshotting logs and metrics to s3://redwood-incidents/1992001234/. I will run local repro with the customer trace and test the de-dupe patch.
Sam (CS - AureliaHealth): Aurelia confirms batch jobs are now completing with decreased failures after we routed to lowmem dedicated pool and disabled prefetch. They will coordinate SDK pin. Thank you team.
Nico (eng-platform): follow-up action: add platform toggle `--tenant-prefetch-max-concurrency` and a default safety value for VPC tenants. I'll schedule a hotfix config release tomorrow.
Lina SRE: creating incident ticket INC-1992001234 and assigning. Postmortem owners please prepare RCA and timeline.
Alex Oncall: closing slack updates; monitoring channel remains open for 60m. If any regression, re-page. Good work. :raised_hands:
